plain: A person or thing that matches or mirrors another.

webster.text: The correspondent part; the part that answers to another, as the two papers of a contract or indentures; a copy; a duplicate.

example.quote: Are we not told, by way of counterpart to language that did him honor, that he would secede ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
